name: Puchong Half Marathon Powered by JomRun®
short_description: A half marathon in Puchong, Selangor, Malaysia, offering 5km, 10km, and 21.1km distances on October 25, 2026.
ai_summary: The Puchong Half Marathon Powered by JomRun® is a road race scheduled for October 25, 2026, based at AEON BiG Puchong Utama in Puchong, Selangor, Malaysia.
